tools.name: dsdx.start
tools.description: START HERE for DS/DS2/DSLText requests: call {} or a short goal. Returns a real official .ds2 example, actual compile receipt, and exact next tool calls. Read-only example, not a generated/adopted user line, registration or physical approval.

tools.name: dsdx.ping
tools.description: Health check and protocol capability probe

tools.name: docs_search
tools.description: Search canonical DS Platform (DSL & DSD) documentation (docs, grammar, contracts, examples, wiki) by keyword and version, returning matching sections, snippets, sourceUrl, specVersion, and buildCommit (Diataxis 5-Pillar SSOT)

tools.name: docs_read
tools.description: Read canonical DS Platform (DSL & DSD) document or specific section with code examples, TOC, sourceUrl, specVersion, and buildCommit (Diataxis 5-Pillar SSOT)

tools.name: dsdx.examples.list
tools.description: List official read-only DS2 starter examples (tutorial-basic, xg5000-demo-kit, library-advanced, carwash-continuous, st-conditions-v2, robot-assembly-cell-v2, etc.) without touching any workspace

tools.name: dsdx.examples.get
tools.description: Read an official read-only DS2 starter example source (.ds2) by id/key and optional lang (ko|en|de|ja) for local editing or WASM play

tools.name: dsdx.library.search
tools.description: Search and count the DualSoft Public 3D Library (/ui/library/), returning total modelCount, industrial category counts, equipment search results, usage rights, and SHA-256 pinned viewer/GLB/ZIP/DS2 links (DISPLAY_PREVIEW, keyless)

tools.name: dsdx.library.get
tools.description: Inspect a single DualSoft Public 3D Library equipment model by id, returning dimensions, units, joints, semantic ports, rights, download descriptors, and verified .ds2 source (DISPLAY_PREVIEW, keyless)

tools.name: dsdx.scene.catalog
tools.description: Search and resolve 3D device library providers (DualSoft public, customer private, local air-gapped) with release version and digest verification (DSDX-3D-PROVIDER-1)

tools.name: dsdx.plc.formats
tools.description: List currently opened PLC vendors and file formats for reverse engineering to ds2 v2; (DS2-SPEC-V2.0) and IDTA 01005 v3.0.1 .aasx (1st release: LS ELECTRIC XG5000 .xgwx only)
